"""Linux PTY transport integration, including device recreation. No Bluetooth radio."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, os, pty, select, subprocess, tempfile, time
parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__); parser.add_argument('--binary', required=True)
args=parser.parse_args(); binary=Path(args.binary).resolve(strict=True)
log=bytearray(); received=bytearray(); master=None; slave=None; process=None
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='lab5-pty-') as directory:
    link=Path(directory)/'serial'
    def new_port():
        global master, slave
        master, slave=pty.openpty()
        if link.is_symlink(): link.unlink()
        link.symlink_to(os.ttyname(slave))
        os.set_blocking(master, False)
    def wait_until(predicate, timeout=6):
        deadline=time.monotonic()+timeout
        while time.monotonic()<deadline:
            if predicate(): return
            descriptors=[process.stdout.fileno()]
            if master is not None: descriptors.append(master)
            ready,_,_=select.select(descriptors,[],[],0.05)
            for descriptor in ready:
                try: chunk=os.read(descriptor,4096)
                except (BlockingIOError,OSError): continue
                (received if descriptor==master else log).extend(chunk)
            if process.poll() is not None: break
        raise RuntimeError('PTY check failed: '+log.decode('utf-8','replace')+' serial='+repr(received))
    try:
        process=subprocess.Popen([str(binary),'--headless','--send-hello','--serial',str(link)],
                                 cwd=binary.parent,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        os.set_blocking(process.stdout.fileno(),False)
        wait_until(lambda: b'Waiting for ' in log)
        assert process.poll() is None, 'Missing device should wait, not exit'
        new_port(); wait_until(lambda: b'hello\n' in received)
        for byte in '你好，Orange Pi!\n'.encode():
            os.write(master,bytes([byte])); time.sleep(0.005)
        wait_until(lambda:'Bluetooth RX: 你好，Orange Pi!'.encode() in log)
        os.write(master,b'without-newline')
        wait_until(lambda:b'Bluetooth RX: without-newline' in log)
        assert received==b'hello\n', 'Raw TTY must not echo input'
        os.write(master,b'old\xe4'); time.sleep(0.2)
        os.close(slave); slave=None; os.close(master); master=None; link.unlink()
        wait_until(lambda:b'Bluetooth disconnected' in log)
        assert process.poll() is None, 'Disconnect should not exit'
        new_port(); wait_until(lambda:log.count(b'Bluetooth serial ready:')==2)
        os.write(master,'新连接\n'.encode())
        wait_until(lambda:'Bluetooth RX: 新连接'.encode() in log)
        assert received==b'hello\n', 'Reconnection must not replay the previous TX queue'
        process.terminate(); process.wait(timeout=3)
        assert process.returncode==0, 'Clean SIGTERM shutdown'
        print(log.decode('utf-8','replace'))
        print('PASS: Linux PTY raw TX, fragmented/idle RX, missing device, recreate/reconnect, clean shutdown.')
        print('Bluetooth pairing/radio and actual screen remain unverified by this test.')
    finally:
        if process and process.poll() is None: process.kill(); process.wait()
        if process and process.stdout: process.stdout.close()
        if master is not None: os.close(master)
        if slave is not None: os.close(slave)
